verdict.rationale: The API overview explicitly lists triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail as a use case. The API and Python SDK let you create agent runs programmatically to fix bugs, and agents can test changes in sandboxes and open PRs, which covers the core story. Missing for 10: a dedicated CI integration guide or worked example (e.g., a pipeline step passing failure logs to an agent), documented automatic triggering on failed checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
